title: ProductCoreDNA
description:
A self-contained slice of Operational DNA materialized for the product layer. Contains the Resources, Operations, Attributes, and Relationships transitively referenced by product.api.json and product.ui.json. Downstream technical cells read this file in place of operational.json — they never read operational DNA directly.

Product core is always DERIVED, never hand-authored. It is regenerated by the product-core-materializer whenever operational.json or the product surfaces change.

Structurally, product core flattens the operational domain hierarchy: Resources live at the top level instead of nested inside Domain.domains[].resources[]. The top-level primitives (operations, rules, etc.) are identical in shape to their operational counterparts and reference the same sub-schemas. State mutations live on `Operation.changes` (no separate Outcome wrapper).

domain.description: The root domain this product core belongs to. Only the identifying fields are retained — the full operational hierarchy is not copied.

path.description: The dot-separated domain path from the platform root.

resources.description: Resources referenced by product.api.json or product.ui.json, flattened from the operational domain hierarchy. Each Resource carries its Attributes and Actions inline. Includes Resources that act as Roles (referenced from Rule.allow[].role or Task.actor) — these were previously surfaced separately as `roles[]`.

users.description: Product-layer projection of the Operational Persons referenced by the product surfaces — the identity/login subjects. Materialized, not hand-authored.

roles.description: Product-layer projection of the Operational Positions referenced by the product surfaces — the RBAC roles read by api auth middleware and ui permission guards. Materialized, not hand-authored.

permissions.description: Reified authorizations (principal + role + scope), the product-layer parallel to operational Memberships. Derive-first from operational Membership + access Rules (carrying a `grants` edge back to the Membership), with author-fallback for permissions that have no backing Membership.

operations.description: Operations surfaced by product.api.json. Each operation references a Resource+Action pair defined in resources[]. Product Core uses Resource as the singular noun reference (operational's wider Target = Resource | Person | Role | Group is collapsed at this layer).

triggers.description: What initiates each surfaced operation or process — user actions, schedules, webhooks, or chained operations.

rules.description: Access and condition rules for surfaced operations. Cells read rules to generate auth middleware and request validators.

relationships.description: Relationships between referenced Resources. Used by db-cell for foreign-key generation and by ui-cell for linked resource navigation.

domain.name: lending
domain.description: Consumer lending domain — loan origination, underwriting, and servicing.

resources.name: Loan
resources.description: A financial loan issued to a borrower with repayment terms.
